He then attended school and played basketball at Westtown, during the 2013–14 academic school year and basketball season, as a high school junior.[http://www.maxpreps.com/news/-vu2vYEFc0K7bGLQqcIg_w/westtowns-georgios-papagiannis-enters-high-school-basketball-with-nba-possibilities.htm Westtown's Georgios Papagiannis enters high school basketball with NBA possibilities.] After his junior year of high school in the United States, he then transferred to the [[American Community Schools|American School]] in [[Athens, Greece]], for his senior year of high school. ==Professional career== Papagiannis made his senior men's club debut with [[Peristeri BC|Peristeri]] on January 5, 2012, at the age of 14, in a [[Greek Basket League]] 2011–12 season game against [[Panathinaikos BC|Panathinaikos]].[http://www.esake.gr/el/action/EsakegameView?idgame=41A19B61&mode=2 ESAKE.gr Day 11 {{el icon}}.] He became the youngest player to ever play in the modern era of the Greek Basket League (since the league first became fully [[professional sports|professional]], under the organization of [[HEBA]], starting with the 1992–93 season).[http://thehoop.blogspot.com/2012/06/real-madrid-set-sights-on-georgios.html TheHoop.com Real Madrid set sights on Georgios Papagiannis.][http://www.real.gr/DefaultArthro.aspx?page=arthro&id=115855&catID=14 Real.gr January 6th, 2012 Παπαγιάννης ο "Βενιαμίν" της Α1 {{el icon}}.] He also spent the 2012–13 season with Peristeri.[http://widgets.baskethotel.com/site/esake/player/4968203/ Career stats & achievements.] ===Panathinaikos=== On June 25, 2014, Papagiannis signed with [[Panathinaikos B.C.|Panathinaikos]] on a multi-year deal,[http://www.paobc.gr/page.ashx?pid=2&aid=24076 PAOBC.gr Επίτευξη συμφωνίας με Γιώργο Παπαγιάννη {{el icon}}.] yet there was a player option in the contract, which allowed him to leave Panathinaikos for a US college during the summer of 2015.[http://www.paobc.gr/page.ashx?pid=2&aid=24076&lang=2 Panathinaikos and Papagiannis reach agreement] Papagiannis, considered to be one of the biggest young European talent prospects, received scholarship offers from 17 USA colleges, including [[University of Connecticut|UConn]], [[University of Arizona|Arizona]], [[Temple University|Temple]],[http://www.sportando.com/en/usa/ncaa/150164/uconn-interested-in-greek-big-man-georgios-papagiannis.html UConn interested in Greek big man Georgios Papagiannis.] [[North Carolina State University|NC State]],[http://collegespun.com/pac-12/oregon-pac-12/report-4-star-center-georgios-papagiannis-wont-play-college-basketball-will-pursue-pro-career-in-greece Report: 4-Star Center Georgios Papagiannis Won’t Play College Basketball, Will Pursue Pro Career In Greece.] [[University of Oregon|Oregon]], [[St. John's University (New York City)|St. John's]], and [[University of Kentucky|Kentucky]].[http://www.si.com/college-basketball/2015/06/30/georgios-papagiannis-recruiting-2015-nba-draft-2016-oregon-kentucky-st-johns Georgios Papagiannis could be recruiting coup.] On July 8, 2015, it was announced that Papagiannis had chosen to continue playing for Panathinaikos.[http://www.eurohoops.net/el/featured-el/108599/αποφάσισε-παο-ο-παπαγιάννης Διάλεξε ΠΑΟ ο Παπαγιάννης {{el icon}}.] His Panathinaikos contract includes a €500,000 [[euros]] buyout option.[http://www.eurohoops.net/featured/266605/papagiannis-flirting-with-the-first-round Papagiannis flirting with the first round.] Papagiannis was a member of the Panathinaikos teams that won both the [[2014–15 Greek Basketball Cup|2015 edition]] and the [[2015–16 Greek Basketball Cup|2016 edition]] of the [[Greek Basketball Cup|Greek Cup]]. On April 24, 2016, Papagiannis was one of 48 international underclassmen to express interest in participating in the [[2016 NBA draft]]. He'd later be one of 13 to officially enter the draft on June 13. He's currently projected as a mid-to-late second round draft pick, although he's said to have garnered a few promises to be taken late in the first round instead.[http://www.basketballinsiders.com/nba-am-is-derrick-rose-on-his-way-out NBA AM: Is Derrick Rose On His Way Out?]/ ==Greek national team== With the [[Greece men's national under-16 and under-17 basketball team|Greek Under-16 junior national team]], Papagiannis played at the [[2012 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]], which he led in blocks per game.[http://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/statistics/p/rpp//tid/291/sid/8814/sp/ALL/ss/BL/srid/ALL/_/2012_U16_European_Championship_Men/player-leaders.html FIBAEurope.com STATISTICAL LEADERS - PLAYERS Blocked Shots.] He also played with Greece at the 2013 [[TBF International Under-16 Tournament]] in Sakarya, Turkey, where he helped Greece win the gold medal. He also played at the [[2013 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]], where he won the bronze medal and was named to the All-Tournament Team,[http://u16men.fibaeurope.com/en/coid_kG7Aj2BgG76iJfEHEBQN,2.articleMode_on.html FIBAEurope.com MVP Peno Leads All Tournament Team.] after leading the tournament in blocks per game.[http://archive.fiba.com/pages/eng/fa/statistics/p/rpp//tid/291/sid/9441/sp/ALL/ss/BL/srid/ALL/_/2013_U16_European_Championship_Men/player-leaders.html FIBAEurope.com STATISTICAL LEADERS - PLAYERS Blocked Shots.] Papagiannis also played at the [[2015 FIBA Under-19 World Championship]], and the [[2015 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]], where he was voted to the All-Tournament Team.[http://u18men.fibaeurope.com/en/compID_8aYeHlfuGF-mF5IqO8aFH1.season_2015.roundID_11484.coid_AlTEzXTKH2wqmCeawxPWg1.articleMode_on.html MVP CHARALAMPOPOULOS HEADLINES ALLL-STAR FIVE.] ==Career
